facts.value: repo row YM43-01 / gate G30 (S01 label 进水闸 read, likely; B): 0.1 km east of G07 藻园门, which matches 贾 2024's 藻园门东进水闸

facts.label: Note
facts.value: [j80:7a] 西南為一空進水閘. 贾 2024 abstract (S348 = S1003, a duplicate in sources.md): 主水自藻园门东进水闸而入. Not new: confirms the repo's placement. Park site page 藻园 (S1234, 2018): the empress dowager came by boat from 畅春园 to 藻园东侧之进水闸 and changed to the 13-bay boathouse's barges; 两岸原为土泊岸，乾隆五十六年改为青山石泊岸二道共长128米 (1791); the south tiger-skin wall east of the inlet rebuilt in place 1996.
